Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Smoke Screen]]: a pack of Winston cigarettes in January 1966, with the first United States warning printed on its side: "Caution: Cigarette Smoking May Be Hazardous to Your Health." Cropped to the pack and reduced to 800 pixels wide.

Source: [https://digital.lib.ecu.edu/8750 Warning label on pack of Winston cigarettes], East Carolina University Digital Collections, Daily Reflector Negative Collection (Greenville, N.C.), dated 1 to 3 January 1966. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240811125326/https://digital.lib.ecu.edu/8750 Internet Archive], 11 August 2024.
